source.table: Table 6. Schedule D-Investments of Federal Government Accounts in Federal Securities, October 2026 and Other Periods
source.title: Table 6. Schedule D — Trust Funds + Grand Total

unit_note: USD millions. Pages 28-29, Table 6 Schedule D: the 41 printed lines from Library of Congress through Grand Total, plus Total Federal Funds re-anchored from p28. Total Treasury Securities adds every trust line except Railroad Retirement Board Agency Securities, which alone makes up Total Agency Securities. Total Trust Funds = Treasury + Agency securities (declared in columns 3-6; Agency Securities prints (**) in columns 1-2), and Grand Total = Total Federal Funds + Total Trust Funds. 82 sums (46 exact, 32 within 1, 3 within 2, 1 of 5; rounding note on p29). The four larger ones are Total Treasury Securities column sums over 28 to 36 lines. The 5 is column 6, whose printed total also meets its own two roll-forwards within 1 and adds exactly into Total Trust Funds. The Grand Total equals Table 6's Federal Securities Held as Investments of Government Accounts line on p23 in all six columns. 'Trust Funds: Other: Treasury Securities' is printed under Independent Agencies, Other; the label follows the earlier months.
